title: Midway
summary: MID'WAY, noun The middle of the way or distance. Paths indirect, or in the midway faint. MID'WAY, adjective Being in the middle of the way or distance; as the midway air. MID'WAY, adverb In the middle

inlines.v: MID'WAY, noun The middle of the way or distance. Paths indirect, or in the midway faint. MID'WAY, adjective Being in the middle of the way or distance; as the midway air. MID'WAY, adverb In the middle of the way or distance; half way. She met his glance midway
